title: Executive Leadership & Strategic Governance
subtitle: Master executive decision-making, strategic alignment, and board-level leadership.
summary: An intensive 8-week offline executive development program designed for directors, C-level leaders, and senior enterprise managers in Bangladesh.
description: The Executive Leadership & Strategic Governance program provides senior executives with actionable frameworks to navigate complex institutional challenges, formulate corporate strategy, and establish high-accountability organizational governance.
learningOutcomes: Formulate agile strategic corporate roadmaps under market volatility
Drive executive board communications and stakeholder alignment
Lead cross-functional organizational restructuring and change management
targetAudience: Senior Vice Presidents and Business Unit Heads
Aspiring enterprise directors with 8+ years management experience
prerequisites: Minimum 5 years of senior managerial or executive leadership experience
Undergraduate degree from an accredited institution

title: Corporate Finance & Capital Structuring
subtitle: Advanced financial modeling, capital budgeting, and enterprise valuation.

Structure optimal debt-equity ratios for capital efficiency
Execute corporate valuation for M&A and private equity funding
Manage working capital and foreign exchange volatility

Treasury Managers and Private Equity Associates
